title: Planner calls the same tool again and again when using google/gemini-2.5-flash from OpenRouter
body: **Describe the bug** Planner’s unreasonable tool-calling behavior **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Use the default planner model id `google/gemini-2.5-flash` together with OpenRouter api key 2. Launch the backend and post a query **Expected behavior** The agent should provide a timely response. **Actual behavior** It keeps thinking and thinking. And the debug log shows what it keeps calling the same tool again and again. **Screenshots** **Environment** Provide essential details about your environment - OS: macOS - ValueCell version or hashtag: latest main
